description_en: Detach the binding relationship based on the user's open information and the device's open information.
description_zh: 根据用户open信息和设备open信息进行解除绑定关系
name: UnbindDevice

fields.help_en: Encoding type. Set this parameter to **PROJECT_ID**.
fields.name: encode_type

fields.help_en: The value corresponding to the encoding type, which is the Project ID of the project where the product resides. You can view it in the Tmall Genie AI platform console.
fields.help_zh: 编码类型对应的值，该产品所在项目的Project ID。请在天猫精灵AI平台控制台中查看
fields.name: encode_key

fields.help_en:
The type of Device ID.  
- OPEN_ID: The default device ID identity.  
- UNION_ID: The organization-dimension device ID identity. You must request an organization in advance on the Open Platform.
fields.help_zh:
设备Id的类型
 - OPEN_ID：默认的设备ID标识。
- UNION_ID: 组织维度的设备ID标识，需要提前在开放平台申请组织
fields.name: id_type

fields.help_en: Device identifier. Enter the value of deviceOpenId or deviceUnionId.
fields.name: id

fields.help_en: Organization ID. This parameter is required if IdType is set to UNION_ID.
